compute_mse: compute the mean squared error between predicted and ground truth image tensors
compute_psnr: compute the peak signal to noise ratio between two images using scikit-image
compute_ssim: compute the structural similarity index between two multichannel images with gaussian weights

compute_ssim_gpu: compute the GPU-accelerated structural similarity index between two image tensors using kornia
